messages:
Mike: Heads-up — our Llama-3Q-quant canary in us-west showed a p99 latency spike and intermittent inference errors after the runtime roll to v2.15.3. Requesting temporary pin of runtime to v2.15.2 for a safety window. @Jen @Sophia

deploy-bot: Pin request created: runtime v2.15.2 for model group 'llama-3q-quant' (scope: hosted,dedicated). Expires in 4h unless removed. Requester: Mike. Reason: canary p99 regression.

Jen: Ack, I'm pulling the canary logs now. Can you paste the failing trace?

Mike: logs look like KV cache miss storm + a few kernel fallback warnings. Sample from canary agent:
```
E 12:34:05 pipeline.cpp:427 kvcache_miss=0.83 fallback_kernel=quant_fast->generic
W 12:34:06 runtime.cpp:218 OOM-like alloc fail (retry)
```

Sophia: That fallback_kernel line is suspicious — the kernel selector might be preferring a new quant path in 2.15.3. If it's a kernel regression, pin is the right immediate move.

Dave: We can patch the kernel selector, but that'll take a micro-release and a verification run. Not fast enough for the window. Support pin.

Jen: Command I'll run: `deployctl pin add runtime v2.15.2 --models llama-3q-quant --expires 4h --reason "canary p99 regression"`

oncall-bot: Paging oncall: there are increased error rates in canary (svc: inference-canary-us-west). Trigger threshold crossed: 0.6%.

Sophia: Quick note: SDK 1.4.0 logs a client warning when server kernel falls back, but it's not user visible otherwise. We should call this out in the release note so early adopters in Dedicated know to restart if they see degraded tail latency.

Mike: Agreed. I'll capture a minimal blurb for notes. Also adding a regression test to the quant kernel matrix.

Jen: Pin applied — PinID pin-2026-2299998880. Routing and canary controllers notified. Will monitor. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: Pin applied by Jen. Pin metadata: {"pin_id":"pin-2026-2299998880","target":"runtime","version":"v2.15.2","expires_in":"4h","scopes":["hosted","dedicated"]} (automated notice)

Mike: Monitoring window started. Will open rollback if errors continue for 10m.

Jen: Quick perf snapshot after pin: p50 stable, p95 trending down, p99 improved from 740ms -> 310ms in first 6m. Rerunning canary traffic now.

Sophia: If soak stays good, propose a soft-unpin plan: wait 2h, run an A/B canary with runtime v2.15.3 but with kernel selector forced to legacy quant, then if green rollforward. If not, keep pin and schedule 2.15.3 revert for quant kernel only.

Dave: Also note Dedicated nodes may need a rolling restart to pick kernel flags; include restart guidance in the notes.

Jen: I'll do two things now: 1) Add the pin removal scheduled task for +2h after approval, 2) Open PR to update release notes with: 'Temporary runtime pin to v2.15.2 for llama-3q-quant due to quant kernel selector regression in v2.15.3; customers on Dedicated may see tail-latency until they restart hosts.'

Mike: Thanks. I'll file an internal postmortem ticket and assign to infra/quant-team for a kernel rollback hotfix.

Jen: Update @ 2299999400 — canary traffic stable for 20m. I'll set a reminder for the soft unpin window in 90m.

deploy-bot: Pin pin-2026-2299998880 expires in 02:10:00 unless extended or manually removed.

Sophia: Closing note: when we unpin, run this checklist: `1) A/B canary with kernel=legacy_quant; 2) verify p99 < 400ms for 15m; 3) smoke test end-to-end client calls; 4) notify Dedicated customers if restarts required.`

Mike: Copy. Will follow up with the PM for release-note blast if we keep pin >4h.

Jen: I'll post an update in #customer-status if Dedicated restarts become necessary. :spiral_calendar:
